meta_data.base_class: Calculate the total revenue of a <industry sector> company over a specific period - refers to a business entity that operates in a defined economic domain such as technology, finance, or manufacturing, whose revenue can be aggregated over time.

tool_template.name: total_<class>_revenue
tool_template.description: Calculate the total revenue of a <class> over a specific period of time.

company.description: Name of the <class> to get data for.

days.description: Number of past days to calculate total revenue for.

data_source.description: Source to fetch the financial data.

currency.description: The currency in which the total revenue of the <class> should be calculated.

include_taxes.description: Whether or not to include taxes in the total revenue calculation for the <class>.

granularity.description: The level of detail for the revenue data (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly) for the <class>.

region.description: The geographic region for which to calculate the total revenue of the <class>.
